title: ID0379258-DC/Si-D/VN-[MP / R3 170001682] OCPP Security Profile 3
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
We would like to confirm that the above Sicharge D MP / R3 170001682 on FW 4.0.11 is capable of supporting OCPP Security profile 3
Root cause: NA
Solution:
Sicharge D do not support Client Certificate / Security profile 3
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: till 4/6/2025

additional_info.subject: VN SiD MP / R3 170001682: OCPP Security Profile 3
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
We would like to confirm that the above Sicharge D MP / R3 170001682 on FW 4.0.11 is capable of supporting OCPP Security profile 3
Please kindly see the attached profile stated on Sicharge D on the backend of Ampeco.
We are aware of the HQ involvement on the Ampeco OCPP Integration testing fronted by Ingo.
However, as RC, we are unable to support OCPP Cert uploading to the Sicharge D.
Would the helpdesk team be able to support on this?
With best regards,
Edna Seah
